LabeledRun.description: Storage envelope binding every row to its required synthetic provenance.
LabeledRun.title: LabeledRun

LabeledTrafficRecord.description: Offline training/evaluation row; target fields must never be inference inputs.

run_id.description: Independent synthetic run; split by this group.
run_id.title: Run Id

timestamp_seconds.description: Elapsed run seconds from synthetic midnight, on a 10-second grid.
timestamp_seconds.title: Timestamp Seconds

approach_id.description: Inbound approach relative to the abstract junction.
approach_id.title: Approach Id

mean_speed_kmh.description: Mean GPS-like sampled speed of vehicles present at t; null iff no samples.
mean_speed_kmh.title: Mean Speed Kmh

free_flow_speed_kmh.description: Run/approach configuration speed; not estimated using held-out traffic.
free_flow_speed_kmh.title: Free Flow Speed Kmh

vehicle_count.description: Vehicles present on the approach at snapshot t.
vehicle_count.title: Vehicle Count

queue_length_vehicles.description: Queued subset of present vehicles at t.
queue_length_vehicles.title: Queue Length Vehicles

mean_wait_seconds.description: Mean elapsed waiting of currently queued vehicles; zero for no queue.
mean_wait_seconds.title: Mean Wait Seconds

incoming_vehicles.description: Approach entries during (t-10,t]; zero at initialization t=0.
incoming_vehicles.title: Incoming Vehicles

outgoing_vehicles.description: Approach exits during (t-10,t]; zero at initialization t=0.
outgoing_vehicles.title: Outgoing Vehicles

current_phase.description: Intersection-wide virtual phase at t; not a physical signal.
current_phase.title: Current Phase

seconds_in_phase.description: Elapsed seconds in the current virtual phase at t.
seconds_in_phase.title: Seconds In Phase

gps_sample_count.description: Distinct currently present vehicles with a valid synthetic speed sample; one per vehicle.
gps_sample_count.title: Gps Sample Count

congestion_level.description: Current rule-derived congestion-v1 index; horizon zero.
congestion_level.title: Congestion Level

future_wait_seconds.description: Mean queue wait at the exact same run/junction/approach snapshot t+60s.
future_wait_seconds.title: Future Wait Seconds
